title: Protocol for isolating single cells from human pancreatic cancer tissues and analyzing major immune cell populations using flow cytometry
protocol: Excise a portion of pancreatic cancer tumor tissue using a sterile scalpel under pathologist guidance.
Ensure the excised tissue block volume is approximately 1 cm × 0.5 cm × 1 cm.
Rinse the surface of the tissue with pre-chilled 1XPBS to remove any stains.
Remove burnt and fatty tissues from the harvested pancreatic cancer tissue.
Immerse the cleaned tissue in a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing approximately 5 mL of tissue preservation solution.
Place the tube on ice.
Transport the tube back to the laboratory for further processing.
Thoroughly wash blood stains from the tissue using pre-cooled 2% FBS-PBS (wash buffer II).
Remove fatty connective tissue from the tissue.
Transfer the cleaned tissue to a 100 mm × 20 mm tissue-culture-treated culture dish containing approximately 2 mL of digestion solution.
Secure the tumor tissue with forceps and cut it into pieces smaller than 1 mm × 1 mm × 1 mm using a scalpel.
Transfer the minced tissue to a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Continue adding digestion solution until the volume reaches approximately 15 mL.
Place the centrifuge tube containing the mixture on a shaker.
Tilt or place the shaker flat and fix it in position.
Set the speed to 150 rpm.
Set the temperature to 37°C.
Set the time to 1 hour.
Filter the digestion system using a 70 μm filter.
Grind the filtered material with a 1 mL syringe plunger.
Filter the supernatant using a 40 μm or 70 μm filter.
Grind the tissue debris using a 1 mL syringe plunger during filtration.
Rinse the filter with cold 2% FBS-1640 (wash buffer II).
Centrifuge the filtrate obtained in step 8 at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Gently aspirate the 36% Percoll solution with a Pasteur pipette.
Resuspend the pellet to a volume of approximately 10 mL.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4°C, with acceleration set at 8 and deceleration at 1.
After centrifugation, discard the supernatant.
Gently aspirate 1 mL of RBC lysis buffer using a pipette.
Resuspend cell pellet in the RBC lysis buffer.
Transfer the resuspended cell suspension into a new 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Add additional RBC lysis buffer to bring total volume up to 10 mL.
Allow the solution to sit at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cells in an appropriate volume (40–200 μL) of wash buffer II based on desired cell quantity for subsequent experiments.
Take 10 μL of the cells and dilute them 10 times.
Mix 10 μL of the diluted cells with an equal volume of 0.4% trypan blue.
Use a cell counter to determine the viability and concentration of cells.
Select approximately 3 × 10^6 cells for flow cytometry and transfer them into a 1.5 mL EP tube.
Centrifuge the selected cells at 500 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells with 50 μL of 2.5 μg/mL Fc blocker.
Incubate the cells on ice for 10 min.
Prepare the staining cocktail by diluting the surface protein antibody with wash buffer II at a ratio of 1:100.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and gently resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of the staining cocktail.
Incubate the cells on ice for 20 min, avoiding exposure to light.
Add 200 μL of wash buffer II to the cell suspension.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Repeat the previous two steps once more.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of fixation/permeabilization solution.
Incubate on ice for 20 min.
Add 200 μL of 1× Perm/wash solution to the cell suspension.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Prepare the staining cocktail by diluting the Intracellular protein antibody with 1× Perm/wash solution at a ratio of 1:100.
Gently resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of the staining cocktail.
Incubate the cells on ice for 20 min, avoiding exposure to light.
Wash cells twice with 200 μL 1× Perm/wash solution.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL PBS for analysis on a five-laser flow cytometer.
